text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the cafeteria bustling with lunch hour 
crowds, Narita Taishin wore a grim 
expression today, just like any other.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
One more meat dish... nah, too much? A 
salad should be fine... but I need 
protein...
choice_data_list:
...You shouldn't force yourself to eat, 
you know?

...You really shouldn't force yourself to 
eat, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They say 'all Uma Musume are hearty 
eaters,' but Narita Taishin has a rather 
small appetite.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She always pushes herself to eat and ends 
up looking pale, which naturally worries 
me, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Shut it. Since you're short to begin 
with, you should at least eat more than 
the rest of us.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: If I don't... I'll never catch up to her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahahaha! My, how wonderful that 
willpower and obsession are!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, pardon the sudden 
intrusion—though people often tell me it's 
rarer when I'm NOT sudden.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Tachyon... What's this all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
As most would have guessed, whenever I 
call upon you—it means a request to 
cooperate with an experiment!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: No way.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, fast, so fast! What ferocious 
footwork!! However, Taishin-kun――

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What if the chemical given to you as a 
sample were something to aid with your 
meals?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, listen here: when it comes to body 
transformation, dietary improvement is 
naturally an indispensable factor.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I have developed! Drug A, which 
"drastically increases digestion speed," 
and Drug B, which "enhances nutrient 
absorption efficiency"!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, Taishin-kun, desiring a 
certain kind of physical modification. How 
do you honestly feel about it...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, I'm not gonna be your 
guinea pig. I'm the one who's going to 
make use of you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In short—negotiations are a success! Now 
then, let the experiment begin...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Knowing how stubborn Narita Taishin is, 
she probably won't listen even if I try to 
stop her... At the very least, I'll 
recommend some safe medicine!"
choice_data_list:
Recommend a drug that drastically 
increases digestion speed

Recommend a supplement to improve nutrient 
absorption

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"What's with jumping in all of a 
sudden...? Well, not like I really cared 
either way."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, upon receiving the medicine, 
Narita Taishin scrunched her brows but 
downed it all in one gulp! And then—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa. What's this? I'm getting 
hungry...! I can still keep eating...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahahaha!! Good, goodâthe results are 
splendid, nothing could be better!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Haha. I can do this, like this...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The effect clearly showed, and at first 
she seemed delighted, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grrr~~~~)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ngggh!! Ugh, again...?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, Taishin-chan...! You're still 
hungry, aren't you? Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'll go prepare some extra midnight snacks 
for you right away. Hehe, please eat lots 
and lots~♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, it's fine, really... Creek-san!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Apparently, due to various reasons, 
they decided to stop taking the 
medication.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"What's with jumping in all of a 
sudden...? Well, not like I really cared 
either way."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, upon receiving the medicine, 
Narita Taishin scrunched her brows but 
downed it all in one gulp! And then—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah... whew.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Mm, I feel like I can still run. Like 
I've got energy to burn...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...She looked quite satisfied, having felt 
the effects firsthand.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Maybe I'll try switching to slightly 
heavier ankle weights."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I've gained some muscle, too...! Fufu.
